description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_RemoveForeignElements, which implements a strategy for removing or transforming unrecognized or foreign HTML tags during HTML purification. It processes tokens obtained from an HTML parser, transforming or removing tags based on site configuration, and handling comments and script contents accordingly.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_RemoveForeignElements
classes.description: A strategy class that removes unrecognized or foreign HTML tags from tokens during purification, transforming them or removing entire sections based on configuration and tag recognition rules.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a list of tokens, removing or transforming unrecognized or disallowed HTML tags, handling comments, and script contents based on configuration settings.
